div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Host
four registers: TX_DATA, RX_DATA,
STATUS, CONTROL
(a CONTROL command restarts the core)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Program ROM
15 built-in programs, slots 1–15

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Program RAM
256 × 16-bit words

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
input lines
UART: RX on gpio_in 0
SPI: MISO on gpio_in 3
I2C: SDA, SCL on gpio_in 0, 1

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
gpio_in[3:0]
four input pins
(WAIT pin, level waits here
until the pin is at the level)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Fetch
the word at pc from the
ROM slot or the RAM

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Execute
one instruction at a time,
each holds for 1 + delay cycles
(JMP loops the program, SKIP bit, level
steps over the next word on a bit
of the input shift register)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Output shift register (8-bit)
shift_dir: LSB or MSB first,
set once by CONFIG shift_dir

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
gpio[3:0]
four output pins, each push-pull
or open-drain (CONFIG open_drain01 / 23:
a 1 then lets go of the line)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Input shift register (8-bit)
fills from the end opposite the wire,
same shift_dir

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Accumulator (16-bit)
ACC_IN: shift in a pin
ACC_CRC: the same, with CRC feedback
from poly (ACC_LOAD fills poly
from the output shift register)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
output lines
UART: TX on gpio 0
SPI: MOSI, SCLK, CS on gpio 0, 1, 2
I2C: SDA, SCL on gpio 0, 1
